hero.subtitle: The Land of the Rising Sun
hero.title: Discover Japan
hero.description: Explore Japan's rich culture, breathtaking landscapes, delicious food, and vibrant cities.

facts.fact: Mount Fuji is the highest mountain in Japan.
Japan's bullet trains can exceed 320 km/h.
Cherry blossoms are Japan's most famous seasonal symbol.
Japan consists of more than 6,800 islands.

testimonials.name: Emma
testimonials.review: Japan was the most beautiful country I have ever visited.

testimonials.name: David
testimonials.review: Kyoto temples and cherry blossoms were unforgettable.

testimonials.name: Sophia
testimonials.review: Tokyo perfectly blends modern technology and tradition.
